usage: As a noun, 蒸蠔 (zing1 hou4) refers to a dish made by steaming oysters.
You can use 蒸蠔 to talk about the dish when ordering food at a restaurant.
The word 蒸蠔 can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
蒸蠔 often appears in menus or food discussions about seafood.
When using 蒸蠔 in sentences, it usually comes with verbs like 食 (to eat), 點 (to order), or 做 (to make).
